description: Apply a JSON Patch (RFC 6902: add, remove, replace, move, copy, test; RFC 6901 pointers) to inline template JSON atomically. Pass the revision validate_template returned as expectedRevision; a stale one fails with revision_conflict. The result must validate, or nothing changes. Returns the updated template, its new revision and the changed paths. `effectProps` edits registered effect props by section name, inside partials too (a registry partial materializes only that instance).

effectProps.description: Effect props merged by expanded section name (partial prefix included), after `operations`.

expectedRevision.description: The revision validate_template (or a previous edit) returned.

from.description: The source pointer for move and copy.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer from the template root, e.g. "/sections/1/options/duration".

value.description: The value for add, replace and test.

name: edit_template
title: Edit Template
